name: Lenvatinib (single-agent oral multikinase inhibitor)
cyclesNote: Continuous once-daily oral dosing (represented as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day continuous-dosing accounting cycle; no drug-free interval). Weight-based: 12 mg once daily for body weight 60 kg or more, 8 mg once daily for under 60 kg. First-line TKI alternative to sorafenib.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Blood pressure control before and during therapy (VEGF-pathway inhibitor); treat hypertension promptly.
Monitor for proteinuria, thyroid dysfunction, hand-foot skin reaction, diarrhea; dose-modify per labeling.
monitoring: blood pressure at baseline and during therapy

doseModificationRules.text: Starting dose is 8 mg once daily for body weight under 60 kg (versus 12 mg for 60 kg or more). Physician decides.
Interrupt and dose-reduce stepwise per labeling; clinical review.

drugs.name: Lenvatinib
drugs.notes: Lenvatinib 12 mg PO once daily for body weight 60 kg or more, or 8 mg PO once daily for under 60 kg, taken continuously. First-line oral multikinase inhibitor for advanced HCC in Child-Pugh A. Authored from standard practice (NCCN Hepatocellular Carcinoma; REFLECT supporting evidence). dosePerUnit shows the 12 mg starting dose; apply the 8 mg starting dose for weight under 60 kg.
